headline: Japan Key Services Inflation Gauge Hits 36-Year High of 4.2 Percent
summary: Japan's key services inflation gauge rose 4.2 percent in October on an annual basis, marking the fastest pace since 1990 and signaling broadening price pressures ahead of central bank meetings.
why: Domestic services inflation is a primary metric monitored by the Bank of Japan for determining the timing of future interest rate hikes.

impacts.name: Nikkei 225
impacts.why: Rising inflation pressures reinforce expectations for Bank of Japan rate hikes.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Accelerating services inflation reinforced market expectations that the central bank will raise interest rates near-term.
